title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, bringing you powerful new capabilities to enhance your productivity.

title: Enhanced File Control
summary: Take full command of your content with new file management tools, allowing you to easily add, organize, and customize the display of images and other files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Now you can easily track our latest updates, discover what's coming next, and glimpse into our exciting long-term vision for the product with our brand-new public roadmap page.

title: Elevated Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and efficient workflow with our enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and seamlessly integrated into our modern interface.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Features
summary: Work together seamlessly in the editor with our new collaboration enhancements, making it clearer and easier to see what everyone is doing.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and collaborate on items shared by your friends, ensuring you always find relevant content when you need it.

title: Empowering Users with Open Source Noeko
summary: Get ready to collaborate as Noeko goes open source, putting more power and transparency directly into your hands.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we expand support to a worldwide audience, making our platform truly global.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Experience a refreshed visual journey with beautifully polished existing themes and an exciting array of new, diverse styles to personalize your workspace.

title: Dynamic Graph View Filters
summary: Gain unparalleled control over your knowledge network with intuitive filters that let you explore your content by tags, time, and shared items, transforming how you discover connections.

title: Dynamic Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge base with advanced filtering by tags and dates, then save your personalized search views for instant access to relevant information.

title: Smarter Content Connections
summary: We're launching enhanced display options for linked content, allowing you to intuitively structure and interact with your notes like never before.

title: Unlock Noeko's Full Potential: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: We're excited to launch Noeko publicly, offering the flexibility of self-hosting alongside new paid plans that unlock advanced features and greater resource capacity.

title: Perfectly Timed Homepage Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and welcoming experience as your homepage greeting now accurately reflects the current time of day.

title: Efficiently Manage Tagged Items with Bulk Actions
summary: Gain powerful control over your content by performing essential actions like unapplying tags and deleting items directly from any list view.

title: Unlock a World of Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in information from a wider variety of sources, like videos and web pages, to enrich your knowledge base and streamline your research.
